mapper.select: SELECT tdm45_manl_relate_ics_id AS manl_relate_ics_id, tdm45_manl_id AS manl_id, tdm45_ics_class_tree_id AS ics_class_tree_id, tdm43_role_nm AS role_name, tdm43_task_nm AS task_name, tdm43_task_relate_detail_nm AS task_detail_name, tdm43_task_relate_duty_nm AS task_duty_name, CONCAT('('||tdm43_manl_cd||') ', tdm43_check_item) AS task_check_item, tdm43_check_how AS task_check_how FROM tdm42_manl_org INNER JOIN tdm43_manl ON tdm43_manl_org_id = tdm42_manl_org_id INNER JOIN tdm45_manl_relate_ics ON tdm45_manl_id = tdm43_manl_id WHERE tdm42_company_id IN (1, 28000) AND #{companyId} = 0 AND f_today() BETWEEN tdm42_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm42_end_date,'2999-12-31'::date) AND tdm45_ics_class_tree_id = #{icsId} AND CONCAT(tdm43_role_nm, tdm43_task_nm, tdm43_task_relate_detail_nm, tdm43_task_relate_duty_nm, tdm43_manl_cd, tdm43_check_item) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY tdm43_role_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" , tdm43_task_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" , tdm43_task_relate_detail_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" , tdm43_task_relate_duty_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" , tdm43_manl_cd

SELECT tdm43_manl_id AS manl_id, tdm43_manl_cd AS manl_code, tdm43_role_nm AS role_name, tdm43_task_relate_duty_nm AS task_relate_duty_name, CASE WHEN tdm43_manl_cd IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE '(' || tdm43_manl_cd || ') ' || tdm43_check_item END AS check_item_add_code, tdm43_check_how AS check_how FROM tdm42_manl_org INNER JOIN tdm43_manl ON tdm43_manl_org_id = tdm42_manl_org_id WHERE tdm42_company_id IN (1, 28000) AND #{companyId} = 0 AND f_today() BETWEEN tdm42_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm42_end_date,'2999-12-31'::date) AND CONCAT(tdm43_role_nm, tdm43_task_nm, tdm43_task_relate_detail_nm, tdm43_task_relate_duty_nm, tdm43_manl_cd, tdm43_check_item) ILIKE #{searchText} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tdm45_manl_relate_ics WHERE tdm45_ics_class_tree_id = #{icsId} AND tdm45_manl_id = tdm43_manl_id ) ORDER BY tdm43_role_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" , tdm43_task_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" , tdm43_task_relate_detail_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" , tdm43_task_relate_duty_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" , tdm43_manl_cd
